observations.behavior: Adds invoice status stage mapping and a tie-break helper, then uses it to rank webhook events by status before timestamp, and adds tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Stripe warehouse ingestion deduplicates events per object; this change makes the deduplication prefer higher-status invoices when timestamps are identical, preventing a stale snapshot from winning over a payment event. Stripe does not deliver events in order, so this is a correctness improvement for warehouse state. No score assigned.
